UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION: Unsupported recipe schema version: {schemaVersion}. Only omrl/v0alpha1 is supported.
UNKNOWN_OPERATION: Unknown operation: {operation}. Only operations from the OMRL catalog are allowed.
INVALID_URI: Invalid virtual URI: {uri}. Allowed schemes: game://, profile://, staging://, package://.
PATH_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Path is outside the approved area: {path}. Writes are limited to the game and profile directories.
MISSING_CAPABILITY: The recipe uses operation {operation} but does not declare the required capability {capability}.
INVALID_VERSION: Invalid version: {version}. Only numeric-dot versions are allowed, e.g. 2026.1.
UNSUPPORTED_GAME_VERSION: This game version ({gameVersion}) does not satisfy the recipe requirement ({range}).
AMBIGUOUS_TARGET: The installation target cannot be determined unambiguously: {reason}. Select a single edition or game version.
GAME_BUILD_UNAVAILABLE: The game version for this installation cannot be determined. Point to an existing installation or choose another compatible mod.
LOADER_UNAVAILABLE: The required mod loader {loader} in version {range} is not available for this installation.
ARTIFACT_MISSING: Artifact file is missing: {artifact}. Download it again or provide a local copy.
ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH: The checksum of {artifact} does not match the declared value. The file may have been tampered with — installation halted.
ARTIFACT_DOWNLOAD_UNAVAILABLE: Artifact {artifact} requires a download that is not available in this version. Use a local copy with a matching checksum.
ARCHIVE_UNSAFE: Archive {artifact} is unsafe: {reason}. Extraction was blocked.
OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION: File {path} does not belong to this recipe or profile. Removal was blocked.
CONFLICT_UNRESOLVABLE: The conflict on {path} between {owners} cannot be resolved automatically. Choose a mod order or remove the conflict.
JOURNAL_DIVERGENCE: The installation state differs from the transaction journal. Choose to resume or restore the previous state.
BASE_GAME_MISMATCH: The game directory {path} already contains base game version {have}, but the recipe requires {need}. Switching the base version under existing mods is not available — use a separate installation or uninstall the mods first.
INSTALL_FACTS_MISSING: The recipe requires the game's {fact}, but Phaket does not know it for this installation. Choose the game build or set the architecture, then plan again.
PLAN_EMPTY: The recipe matched no steps for this installation, so there is nothing to do. No files were changed and nothing was registered as installed.
